sections.heading: 1. Slow and comfortable
lines: ① Cat-cow: about 8 slow rounds (1 min).
② On your back, rock knees side to side (1 min).
③ Half-kneeling hip stretch, 30 sec each side.
④ Glute stretch 30 sec a side; child's pose 1 min.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get advice if…

slides.title: When to get it checked
slides.bubble:
Causes differ for everyone.
An assessment comes first!
slides.heading: Get assessed if you notice

caption:
Mr Turtle freezes halfway through putting his socks on. Long days of sitting can leave the hips and lower back feeling stuck.

Hybi's 5-minute routine: about eight slow rounds of cat-cow, a minute of knee rocks on your back, a half-kneeling hip stretch for 30 seconds each side, a glute stretch, then a minute in child's pose. Move gently and within comfort.

Pain spreading down a leg with pins and needles or weakness, numbness around the groin, bladder or bowel changes, fever, or pain after a fall are worth an assessment first. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can tailor a routine to how you move. Book online via the link in bio 🧘

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
